svg.title: Pretty Fish: from drawing to painting
svg.desc: A seed and proportions go to fishdraw, which generates anatomy and fine lines. Body, head and fin regions are preserved, then nonflowers routines add colour washes, tapered ink, pigment variation and a fixed paper background.
svg.text: From an imaginary fish to a painted specimen

g.text: One anatomy throughout · original forms and painting routines by LingDong Huang
Retain the fill masks and detail paths
For a morph: interpolate proportions, regenerate the fish, and paint every frame over one fixed sheet of paper.
